name: Chioma
blurb: A popular student experiencing escalating jealousy and stalking.

nodes.text: Chioma is studying in her hostel room.
Dayo is waiting downstairs with food! He's so sweet.
Four places she turns to for assistance. None offer safety.

doors.label: Roommate
doors.text: Please don't ruin his future over a small issue.

doors.label: Lecturer
doors.text: This sounds like a private issue to settle between yourselves.

doors.label: Campus Security
doors.text: Lovers quarrel. Go back to your hostel.

doors.label: Mother
doors.text: Be patient, my dear. I will pray for both of you.
